description: Read-only introspection. Returns the recorded SchemaDefinition snapshot and per-table status (active or inactive) for the namespace, plus install/update/uninstall timestamps.
embedding_description: Read-only introspection: return the recorded SchemaDefinition snapshot and per-table status (active/inactive) for a plugin namespace, plus install/update/uninstall timestamps. Returns object with namespace + tables map (each entry: status, schema_snapshot, installed_at, updated_at, uninstalled_at). Use to inspect what's installed before mutating; unknown namespace returns empty tables dict.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Object with namespace and tables map. Each table entry has status, schema_snapshot, installed_at, updated_at, uninstalled_at.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Reads platform__plugin_schema_ownership for the namespace and returns recorded snapshots.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: Postgres connectivity errors; otherwise an unknown namespace simply returns an empty tables dict (not an error).
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For Postgres errors: confirm postgres_state_management_plugin is healthy.
